outline: OFDM和MIMO技術為現今與下世代通訊系統之關鍵技術。許多無線通訊協定，例如802.11a/g 無線區域網路，皆採用此項技術。本門課提供學生在基頻MIMO/OFDM 系統設計之訓練。並需要跨領域之通訊理論和IC 設計之背景。此課程將以授課教授本身設計之IC當作例子。所有學生在期末時亦需要用Matlab/C/Verilog來實現一個通訊系統。
schedule:
預計進度 (按實際教學狀況調整)
Week 1 Introduction
Week 2 Signal Propagartion and Channel Model
Week 3 Information theoretic results
Week 4 Digital Modulation
Week 5 OFDM
Week 6 Error Correcting Codes / Channel coding
Week 7 Error Correcting Codes / Channel coding
Week 8 Synchronization
Week 9 Channel Estimation
Week 10 Equalization
Week 11 From Algorithm to Bit True Design
Week 12 Circuit Techniques
Week 13 MIMO Channel Model
Week 14 MIMO Techniques
Week 15 Multiple access scheme
Week 16 System Examples
